title: Handoff lifecycle, archive and target confirmation
summary: Make handoff lifecycle reliable across Pi, MCP, server and Web UI.
description: Completed handoff lifecycle hardening across core, Pi, MCP, server, and Web UI. PlanStore now archives stale handoffs when phases become done/canceled, archives replaced content as superseded, rejects new writes to terminal phases, repairs legacy stale data, filters listHandoffs() to active non-orphan phases, and exposes archived handoff summaries from `.planner/.local/handoff-archive/`. Pi lifecycle mutation paths now call syncTaskStatusRollup(); Pi/MCP handoff tools require explicit phaseRef and confirmed=true after the agent proposes the exact feature+phase and receives user confirmation, with no first-in-progress fallback. Server exposes `/handoffs/archive`; Web UI keeps `/handoff` pending-only and adds `/handoff/archive` for recoverable history. Files: packages/plan-core/src/plan-store.ts, packages/plan-core/test/handoff-lifecycle.test.mjs, packages/pi-adapter/src/index.ts, packages/plan-mcp/src/index.ts, packages/plan-server/src/serve.ts, packages/plan-web-ui/src/routes/handoff.route.tsx, packages/plan-web-ui/src/routes/handoff-archive.route.tsx, router/API/types, and copied web-ui-dist bundles. Validation: pnpm -r build, pnpm check, focused core tests pass; no commit/push performed.
completionCriteria: Phase completion archives its pending handoff in every Pi/MCP/server lifecycle path.
repair() and listHandoffs() clean legacy terminal-phase handoffs; active list excludes archived/terminal/orphan entries.
Handoff target is proposed from conversation/context and requires explicit user confirmation before write; no implicit phase fallback remains.
Archived handoffs are recoverable through PlanStore/server and visible only at /handoff/archive.
Build, typecheck, focused regression tests, and generated UI bundle validation pass.

tasks.title: Core handoff lifecycle and archive cleanup
tasks.description:
Update packages/plan-core/src/plan-store.ts around syncTaskStatusRollup(), clearPhaseHandoff(), listHandoffs(), repair(), and setPhaseHandoff(). Preserve the existing phase-scoped handoff and handoffHistory archive under .planner/.local/handoff-archive/, but make completion cleanup reliable and idempotent: archive stale handoffs when a derived phase reaches done, sweep legacy stale done handoffs during repair, hide done/canceled/orphan entries from the active list, and reject new writes to completed phases. Add a core archive listing/read model suitable for the Web UI while retaining the five-entry history cap and clear reasons. Cover legacy plans and malformed/missing archive files without losing current phase JSON data.

---
**Completion summary:**
Implemented core handoff lifecycle hardening in packages/plan-core/src/plan-store.ts: added ArchivedPhaseHandoffSummary/listArchivedHandoffs(), rejected writes to done/canceled phases, archived replaced handoffs as superseded, filtered active list to non-done/non-canceled/non-orphan phases, added cleanupStaleHandoffs() and repair() retroactive stale cleanup. Added packages/plan-core/test/handoff-lifecycle.test.mjs covering supersede archive, repair cleanup, active filtering, and done-phase write rejection. Verified core build and 18 focused handoff/resume tests pass.

tasks.title: Pi and MCP handoff targeting and lifecycle integration
tasks.description:
Update packages/pi-adapter/src/index.ts and packages/plan-mcp/src/index.ts. Invoke PlanStore.syncTaskStatusRollup() after every Pi task lifecycle mutation (task start, complete, status update, delete where applicable) to match existing MCP/server behavior. Remove the first-in-progress fallback from handoff resolution and make writes fail safely without a resolved target; implement prepare as a proposal flow that derives the most recent non-done work context, presents the exact F/P/T target for user confirmation, and writes only after confirmation. Never propose or write an operational handoff on a derived done/canceled phase. Keep show/list/clear semantics explicit, preserve composite identifiers, and align all tool descriptions/protocol text so they no longer instruct agents to guess or write immediately.

---
**Completion summary:**
Integrated Pi lifecycle paths with PlanStore.syncTaskStatusRollup() so phase completion archives handoffs; task completion responses now report archived phase handoffs. Removed implicit first-in-progress handoff resolution in Pi and MCP. Handoff writes/clears/shows now require explicit phaseRef; writes require confirmed=true after the agent proposes the exact target and receives user confirmation. Updated Pi prepare prompt, MCP prepare tool, legacy handoff tools, and CLI help. Verified core/pi-adapter/mcp builds and pnpm check.

tasks.title: Handoff archive API and Web UI route
tasks.description:
Extend packages/plan-server/src/serve.ts and packages/plan-web-ui/src/routes/handoff.route.tsx plus route registration and API types. Keep GET /handoffs limited to pending handoffs on non-done phases, add an archive endpoint that reads PlanStore archive metadata/content, and expose a separate /handoff/archive/ page or nested view. The active page must never render archived or completed-phase handoffs; the archive page should show phase composite ref, feature context, archived timestamp, reason, and recoverable content without allowing archived entries to become active accidentally. Preserve LAN/WS updates, clear behavior, responsive layout, and existing deep links to active phase handoffs.

---
**Completion summary:**
Added PlanStore archive listing consumed by plan-server GET /handoffs/archive. Extended Web UI types/API and created /handoff/archive route with archived timestamp/reason/file/content, while active /handoff now links to archive and only displays pending entries from the filtered core list. Verified core/server/web-ui builds.
